name: PatchGrid
subtitle: Live-event file delivery and coordination
summary: Born from a real live-production problem: teams exchanging console and show files through filenames, dates, and version suffixes with no clear authoritative copy. PatchGrid is now a production SaaS used by dozens of users.

name: MSAR V2 / ITRI
subtitle: Computation orchestration across multiple teams
summary: An integration layer connecting frontend requests, DB APIs, frequently changing computation modules, result artifacts, and persistence. The architecture isolates team-owned code behind explicit execution boundaries.

name: Messaging Platform
subtitle: High-volume multi-provider notification delivery
summary: Production push and SMS delivery handling 1M+ push notifications and 50K+ SMS messages per day, with five SMS providers, retry behavior, delivery-state tracking, and operational troubleshooting.

name: Customer Operations Platform
subtitle: Production takeover and workflow performance
summary: An existing operational platform I took over end-to-end. A 12-tab user detail view was changed from blocking full-page loading to independent lazy-loaded tabs, while sensitive state changes use layered revalidation.

name: Duty-free Incentive Platform
subtitle: Recoverable Oracle-to-SQL data workflow
summary: ETL and calculation workflows for complex store, product, team, and item-specific incentive rules, including explicit handling of incomplete, malformed, failed, and orphan records.

name: Residential BMS Portal
subtitle: Legacy portal takeover, calculation and reporting
summary: Extended an existing ASP.NET Framework portal for a large residential common-area BMS. Vendor-collected Modbus data lands in a database; the application adds electricity-cost estimation and equipment-point trend analysis.

name: EcclesiaNexus
subtitle: Hybrid cloud/edge church operations platform
summary: A substantial greenfield Go + React system under active development. Implemented foundations include a PostgreSQL cloud core, SQLite edge agent, multi-tenant IAM, WAMS, roster/scheduling, People, Check-Ins, Groups, notification workflows, CI, deployment tooling, and real-database integration tests.

name: Building Systems Integrations
subtitle: Daikin HVAC and Lite-Puter lighting into Home Assistant
summary: Real deployments integrating building systems beyond their vendor software: Modbus TCP for Daikin HVAC and a reverse-engineered proprietary UDP protocol for Lite-Puter lighting control.

name: LINE + LLM Messaging Prototype
subtitle: Conversational backend with persistent users and rooms
summary: A working LINE-to-LLM prototype with a separate backend, JWT authentication, persistent chat rooms and messages, and Firestore. The engagement stopped before production when API operating cost changed the business case.

name: Midas Personal IEM Controller
subtitle: Role-scoped monitor control over OSC
summary: A prototype motivated by the native iOS app being too broad for musicians: expose only a user's own monitor mix and a deliberately limited control surface.
